conviction_note: Small net negative. The stock is up 56% in 20 days and sits at its 52-week high on two order PRs (Aug 11 medical line $3.6m+, Sep 30 clean-energy $7.19m) that both ship mainly in FY2028. The FY2027 guide (flat to modestly higher on $20.9m) was restated at the Aug 20 annual meeting and has no path to move on those orders. The CEO flagged that Q1's 57% gross margin is not representative, and the EPS bar is disputed ($0.04 vs $0.05). Against that sit possible FY2028 colour on the call and net-hold insider exercises. abs_move 6.5 rests on 76.7% realised vol and four confirmed earnings reactions (-3.57, -0.48, -8.47, +3.69). p_up is 45, not lower, because the bar is disputed and the history is short. The findings sum to -0.7 and the scaled number is -0.65; they agree.
bar: Disputed and capped. EPS next quarter $0.04 on finviz (https://finviz.com/quote.ashx?t=SOTK, read 2026-10-13); the sweep row carries a one-analyst $0.05. No sourced revenue consensus. Company guide: H1 FY27 revenue growth (H1 FY26 $10.30m, so Q2 > $4.64m clears it) and FY27 flat to modestly higher than $20.9m (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/806172/000117152026000166/ex99-1.htm). print_vs_bar is on EPS: my read is about $0.03-0.045 against a $0.045 midpoint.
positioning_check: Short float 0.28%, short ratio 0.51 days, 0.04m shares short (finviz, https://finviz.com/quote.ashx?t=SOTK, page read 2026-10-13). Not crowded, so there is no squeeze mechanism against the negatives. No option chain, so no skew. Run-up +56.2% over 20 days, 1.8% off the 52-week high: the order news is in the price.

findings.finding: The FY2027 guide has no path to rise on the two new orders. The $3.6m+ medical line (Aug 11) and the $7.19m clean-energy order (Sep 30) both ship mainly in FY2028 (from 1 March 2027). The Aug 20 annual-meeting deck restated FY27 as flat to modest growth and flagged US clean-energy policy headwinds. Q1 had no solar shipments and clean energy fell 90%. So the print most likely reiterates a flat year into a +56% run.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: May 28 2026, when the FY27 flat-to-modest guide was first given with record FY26 profit: -8.47%. Oct 14 2025, guide raised to modest growth: -3.57%.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market were pricing the FY28 delivery timing, the stock would not have run 56% in 20 days to its 52-week high on orders that add nothing to FY27 revenue. The run is priced as growth that the FY27 guide will not show.
findings.independence: The Sep 30 order PR states FY2028 delivery (https://finviz.com/news/396901/sono-tek-announces-record-719-million-in-orders-from-advanced-clean-energy-sector-customer). The Q1 10-Q cites no solar shipments and reduced electrolysis demand (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/806172/000117152026000167/eps12663_sotk.htm). Both are company documents, so this is not fully independent of the deck.

findings.finding: Gross margin is likely to fall back from Q1's 57%. The CEO said in the Q1 release that this level is not representative of every quarter, and FY26 ran at 51% with Q3 at 50%. At about $5.5m revenue and 51-53% margin, operating income is about $0.5-0.6m and EPS about $0.03-0.04, at or below a disputed $0.04-0.05 bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Jul 8 2026, a margin beat (57%) with 10% growth: +3.69%. The margin line has paid on the upside, so a reversal is the mirror case.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus at $0.04-0.05 with one analyst implies Q1-like margins. A bar priced for reversion would sit near $0.03, the Q2 FY26 level.
findings.independence: Q3 FY26 gross margin of 50% from the Jan 13 2026 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/806172/000117152026000002/ex99-1.htm). The bar is unsourced to two agreeing estimates, so this finding is capped small.

findings.finding: Backlog. May 31 backlog was $7.73m; the $3.6m+ medical line booked in Q2 ships in FY28, so Aug 31 backlog is likely about $10-11m. That is below the $12.26m record of Nov 2025. Counting the Sep 30 order, current backlog is likely about $17m+, a record the release or call will probably state.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Jan 13 2026, record backlog of $12.26m announced: -0.48%. Backlog records have not moved this stock on print days; the order PRs themselves did (+18% on Sep 30).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: both orders are public and the stock ran on them. The unpriced part is any first FY2028 framing on the call ('accelerated growth in subsequent years' in the Aug 20 deck). If it were priced, there would be no upside left to a quantified FY28 outlook.
findings.independence: Aug 20 annual-meeting deck: 'strong foundation in place for accelerated growth in subsequent years' (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/806172/000117152026000231/page_19.jpg). This shares a company source with finding 1, read in the opposite direction on a different fiscal year (FY28 against FY27), so the two do not contradict.

findings.finding: Five insiders (CEO, CFO, COO, a VP and a director) exercised options on Oct 5-8 2026 at $3.25-4.12. They paid the exercise price by surrendering shares (code F) and kept the net shares, with no open-market sales after the 56% run. In July 2026 the CFO and the chairman sold at about $5.1-5.4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No history; Form 4 clusters have not been tested on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Form 4 option exercises do not reach the wire. Had the market read them as a signal, the stock would not have eased 1.8% on Oct 13. The options run to 2034-2035, so an early exercise is a weak choice signal, not routine expiry.
findings.independence: finviz insider table lists all five exercises and no sales after July (https://finviz.com/quote.ashx?t=SOTK). Same underlying filings.

findings.finding: The Q2 revenue floor is supported. The $5m+ medical order of Sep 2025 delivers over about 12 months from CY2026 and drove Q1 medical to $3.95m. The 10-Q expected an industrial rebound in Q2. So revenue at or above Q2 FY26's $5.16m is likely, but that sits inside the H1 growth guide, and two customers made up 53% of Q1 sales, so the quarter is lumpy.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced, because it is inside guidance. The residual is that no revenue consensus is visible, so the size of any revenue beat is unanchored.
findings.independence: Sep 3 2025 order PR, deliveries over about 12 months from CY2026 (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/09/03/3143442/0/en/Sono-Tek-Wins-Order-for-Medical-Device-Coating-Systems-Valued-at-Over-5-Million.html).

outside_window.finding: Delivery of the $7.19m clean-energy order (10 systems) and the $3.6m+ medical line, mainly in FY2028 starting 2027-03-01.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Baseline reaction history as an earnings base rate (8 rows including non-earnings 8-Ks and a duplicate)
rejected_candidates.detail: Rebuilt from confirmed releases instead: Oct 14 2025 -3.57, Jan 13 2026 -0.48, May 28 2026 -8.47, Jul 8 2026 +3.69. The Aug 20 2026, Nov 12 2025 and Sep 3 2025 rows are the annual meeting and order PRs.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with. The findings lean against the +56% run-up, which already holds the order news, while thin short interest (0.28%) means there is no squeeze behind the stock.
lessons_applied: Lesson 6 (bar disputed, $0.04 vs $0.05, no revenue consensus): EPS/margin finding capped from -1.0 to -0.6.
Lessons 1 and 3 plus the core table (guide is already public, so a reiteration lands inside guidance): FY27-guide finding cut from -1.5 to -1.0; p_up moved from 42 toward 50, to 45.

'History from the wrong events': base rate rebuilt from the four confirmed releases. That turned up the $12.26m Nov 2025 record backlog, which bought -0.48% on Jan 13 2026, so the backlog finding went from +0.5 to +0.4 and was re-scoped (Aug 31 backlog is not a record; the post-September total is).
Medical-revenue finding is inside the H1 guide: cut from +0.3 to +0.2.
Lesson 8 and the possibility of first FY28 commentary: abs_move_pct raised from 6.0 to 6.5.
